source: Car & General (Kenya) Plc summary consolidated audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, consolidated statement of profit or loss (Shs thousands read as ABSOLUTE KES). FY2025 and FY2024 columns read from the audited summary filed with the Nairobi Securities Exchange; FY2023 to FY2021 rows retained from kenyanstocks.com financial statements API (farmed). | kenyanstocks.com financial statements API, farmed harvest. Profit Before Tax derived as Net Profit plus Income Tax; Gross Profit as Revenue minus Cost of Sales. Cross checked: Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit and Revenue minus Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit. Filled 2026-10-01 from the kenyanstocks.com comprehensive income API: Income Tax FY2021 from the source line Taxation Charge/ Credit; Income Tax FY2022 from the source line Taxation Charge/ Credit; Income Tax FY2023 from the source line Taxation Charge/ Credit; Income Tax FY2024 from the source line Taxation Charge/ Credit. CRON 2026-10-06: EPS for FY2023, FY2022, FY2021 derived as Net Profit divided by shares outstanding (80206616 shares per kenyanstocks.com /data/stocks/v1/all (field shares_issued)). The 2 already-stored EPS figure(s) in this file reproduce that identity within 3 percent, and none contradict it. | CRON 20261014: H1 2026 column read from Car and General (Kenya) Plc summary consolidated unaudited results for the half year ended 30 June 2026 (Shs thousands read as absolute KES): revenue 15,636,492; gross profit 2,961,747; other income 77,712; impairment provision for financial assets 47,915; operating expenses 1,649,972; share of profit in an associate 2,038,692; profit before finance costs, net foreign exchange gains and taxation 3,380,264; finance costs 573,729; finance income nil; net foreign exchange gains 69,176; profit before taxation 2,875,711; taxation charge 271,257; profit for the period 2,604,454, of which attributable to shareholders 2,587,824 and non controlling interests 16,630; basic and diluted EPS 32.26. Cost of Sales is the arithmetic complement of the printed revenue and gross profit, the construction the stored years of this file already use. Ties: revenue less cost of sales equals the printed gross profit; gross profit less operating expenses plus other income plus share of associate less impairment equals the printed 3,380,264, the identity that reproduces this file FY2025 EBIT of 3,477,328 exactly; profit before taxation less taxation equals the printed 2,604,454. Read by OCR of the published summary, which has no extractable text layer.
source_note: FY2024 rows restated to the audited comparative where the farmed file differed: operating profit was stored as gross profit less administration only (1,711,925 thousand) against the audited profit before finance costs and taxation of 1,111,985 thousand; operating expenses covered administration only against the audited 2,610,942 thousand, the sum of administration and selling and distribution; tax was stored as the current charge of 22 thousand against the audited net charge of 99 thousand. Net finance costs are finance costs less finance income; profit before tax also includes net foreign exchange gains of 27,214 thousand (FY2025) and 27,308 thousand (FY2024).
